m267.current_github_head_status: IMAGE helper family is complete and VAX-green at eb320246. Canonical @BUILD passed all regressions with BUILD_STATUS=%X00000001 and focused @BUILD_M259 passed all implemented M259 image-input regressions with M259_STATUS=%X00000001 after restoring the long file set in several shorter verified GIT_RESTORE.COM batches. details: SRC/LLM_TRANSPORT.C/H and LLM_TRANSPORT.OBJ are the neutral production transport module/artifact.
SRC/LLM_INTERNAL.H includes LLM_TRANSPORT.H directly.
Temporary SRC/OPENAI_TRANSPORT.H shim was deleted on GitHub and physically removed on OpenVMS.
perform_openai_request remains intentionally OpenAI-compatible protocol naming for the /responses wire operation.
GitHub compare from 883c320d to 973a0778 was exactly LLM_INTERNAL.H +1/-1 plus deletion of the seven-line shim.
OpenVMS RMS-aware restore verified SRC/LLM_INTERNAL.H; canonical @BUILD passed all regressions with BUILD_STATUS=%X00000001.
Production source/header are SRC/LLM_AGENT_CTX.C and SRC/LLM_AGENT_CTX.H; build/link artifact is LLM_AGENT_CTX.OBJ.
Exported APIs are llm_agent_ctx_reset, llm_agent_ctx_add_items, llm_agent_ctx_add_tool, llm_agent_ctx_write, and llm_agent_ctx_write_final; all are <=31 characters.
File-local macro, state, and helper names in the module were also neutralized so no generic OpenAI namespace remains inside AGENT_CTX.
SRC/OPENAI_REQUEST_AGENT.C is the sole branch-live production consumer and now includes LLM_AGENT_CTX.H and calls only llm_agent_ctx_* APIs for this family.
Legacy SRC/OPENAI_AGENT_CTX.C and .H were deleted; no compatibility shim remains.
OpenVMS GIT_RESTORE.COM restored and verified all five live files in a quoted comma-separated batch; stale OPENAI_AGENT_CTX.C, OPENAI_AGENT_CTX.H, and OPENAI_AGENT_CTX.OBJ were physically removed.
Canonical VAX @BUILD passed all regression tests with BUILD_STATUS=%X00000001.
Generic helper source/header/artifact are SRC/LLM_IMAGE.C, SRC/LLM_IMAGE.H, and LLM_IMAGE.OBJ; legacy OPENAI_IMAGE.C/H are deleted with no shim.
Helper namespace is llm_image_meta, llm_image_info, llm_image_write_data, llm_image_log, and LLM_IMAGE_PATH_MAX; external names are <=31 characters.
OpenAI-compatible input_image/image_url JSON fields remain intentionally in request modules and were not renamed.
openai_agent_image* names remain explicitly deferred to the broader AGENT family rather than mixed into the image-helper slice.
BUILD_M259.COM uses LLM_IMAGE.OBJ, LLM_JSON_WRITE.OBJ, and LLM_MODULES.OPT so focused acceptance does not depend on stale OpenAI-named artifacts.

The first VAX restore attempt exceeded the DCL command-element limit and failed with %DCL-W-TKNOVF before any requested batch restore completed. The same file set was then split into four shorter GIT_RESTORE.COM batches; all files were restored and verified.

After the verified short-batch restores, canonical @BUILD passed all regressions with BUILD_STATUS=%X00000001 and @BUILD_M259 passed all implemented M259 image-input regressions with M259_STATUS=%X00000001.
